content_sections.heading: MP Police Constable Driver Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian citizens and satisfy the educational, driving licence, age and other conditions prescribed in the MPESB rulebook. In addition to the educational qualification, candidates must possess a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence . A separate practical trade test will also be conducted and qualifying it is mandatory. Candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh can apply only against Unreserved Open vacancies. Such candidates are not eligible for reservation or age-relaxation benefits available to Madhya Pradesh domiciles.

rows.educational_qualification: Passed Class 10 under 10+2 system, Higher Secondary or equivalent examination from a recognized Board/Institution

content_sections.heading: MP Police Constable Driver Salary
content_sections.text: According to the rulebook, during the initial period, stipend is payable at 70% of the minimum pay scale in the first year, 80% in the second year and 90% in the third year, in accordance with the applicable Madhya Pradesh Government provisions. Other allowances and benefits sanctioned by the State Government from time to time will also apply.

content_sections.heading: MP Police Constable Driver Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process has two major stages. First Stage - Online Written Examination Second Stage - Physical Efficiency Test, Document Verification and Trade Test Each correct answer carries 1 mark. No mark will be deducted for a wrong or unanswered question. Based on the written examination cut-off percentile, candidates up to seven times the advertised vacancies under vertical reservation will be shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test. Candidates obtaining the same cut-off percentile will also be called even if the total exceeds seven times the vacancy count. The Physical Efficiency Test carries a maximum of 40 marks and consists of an 800-metre run. Candidates get one opportunity for the run. For regular candidates, a minimum of 20% marks in the 800-metre run and at least 30% of the total Physical Efficiency Test marks, i.e. 8 marks out of 40, are required. The driving trade test is qualifying in nature. Candidates must pass the practical trade test for final selection. Final selection for Constable Driver will be made from candidates who qualify in the Physical Efficiency Test and Trade Test, based on the percentile obtained in the first-stage written examination, subject to successful document verification and other eligibility conditions. The rulebook prescribes separate physical measurement standards for the Special Armed Force and other applicable categories. For Special Armed Force male candidates in the general/OBC category, the prescribed standard includes a minimum height of 168 cm and chest measurement of 79 cm unexpanded and 84 cm expanded. Other category-specific standards are provided in the rulebook and should be checked before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MP Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through MP Online for the MPESB Constable Driver Selection Test. Visit the MP Online website at www.mponline.gov.in. Open Citizen Services. Select the MPESB/ESB application link. Open the MP Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2026 application. Read the examination instructions and rulebook carefully. Complete Aadhaar-based registration as required. Fill in personal, educational, category and other required details. Upload the prescribed photograph and supporting details. Pay the applicable examination and portal fee. Submit the application form. Keep the online application number safely for downloading the admit card.

content_sections.heading: MP Police Constable Driver Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The recruitment is only for male candidates. Aadhaar registration is mandatory. Candidates must bring an original photo identity proof to the examination centre. Accepted ID proof includes Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence or Passport. Verified e-Aadhaar will be accepted. Multi-level biometric verification will be conducted during the examination process. Aadhaar should remain unlocked during biometric verification. Candidates must reach the examination centre within the specified reporting time. Mobile phones, calculators, digital watches, log tables and other prohibited electronic devices are not allowed. The downloaded admit card and a black ball-point pen must be carried to the examination centre. Candidates must keep the online application number safely. All required eligibility certificates must be available by 29 October 2026. Original documents will be checked during document verification in the second stage. Selected candidates may be posted anywhere according to departmental requirements. Selected candidates will not be allotted their home district. A candidate posted to a unit normally has to complete at least 5 years of service there before becoming eligible for transfer to another unit. The number of advertised vacancies may increase or decrease. Applicants must satisfy all applicable domicile, reservation, age and licence conditions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting the MP Police Constable Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment exam is conducted by the Madhya Pradesh Staff Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal for the Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 1000 vacancies have been notified for the post of Constable (Driver), which includes 200 posts for Special Armed Force and 800 posts for District Police Force.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 29-10-2026 up to 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for MP Police Constable Driver?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th class examination (8th class for ST candidates) under the 10+2 system or equivalent, along with a valid heavy motor vehicle driving licence.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for unreserved candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for unreserved male candidates from Madhya Pradesh and all candidates from other states is 33 years as of 29/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC, ST, OBC, and EWS candidates who are native residents of Madhya Pradesh is Rs. 250/-, while unreserved candidates must pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q7. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The tentative examination date starts from 04-01-2027.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the written test?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking for incorrect or unattempted answers in the online written test.

faq.question: Q9. Can female candidates apply for Constable (Driver) posts?
faq.answer: No, these posts are strictly for male candidates only.

faq.question: Q10. What is the pay scale for MP Police Constable Driver?
faq.answer: The pay scale is 19500-62000 (Pay Level-4) with stipendiary payments applicable during the first three years as per government norms.
